title: Hybrid ML-Markov Dynamic Pricing for Perishable Products
summary: A runnable reproduction of a paper on dynamic pricing and inventory optimization for perishable products, combining ML demand models with an MDP pricing policy over a synthetic product-day dataset. The dataset generator optionally imports sdv's SingleTableMetadata and CTGANSynthesizer to augment synthetic data around real-world price/shelf-life statistics, falling back to a deterministic bootstrap if sdv is unavailable.
